title: Care Desk Guidance: Moving Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Visits to Another Pet
content:
**Guidance.** On a Tailwise Grooming Salon pass the pass status is active when the transfer is requested. Where the pass allows transfers, the remaining visits may be moved to another pet of the same customer whose species is in the pass's species list and whose current size class is not larger than the pass's size class at purchase; a larger pet is not transferable because the pass was priced for the smaller size. The expiry date, the visits remaining and the discount already given stay as they are; open bookings for the old pet are cancelled without fee.

Whether a pass allows transfers, and its species list, are set per pass in the pass terms table and the rate card. The status and size class at purchase are read from the pass record, and the receiving pet's species and current size class from that pet's record.

**Conditions for the receiving pet**

| Test | Passes when |
|---|---|
| owner | the pet belongs to the same customer as the pass |
| species | the pet's species is in the pass's species list |
| size | the pet's current size class is the same as, or smaller than, the size class at purchase |

**Size test (hypothetical Full Groom Pass 4-Visit bought for a medium dog)**

| Receiving pet | Transferable |
|---|---|
| small dog of the same customer | yes |
| medium cat of the same customer | yes — cats are in the Full Groom species list |
| large dog of the same customer | no — larger than the size class at purchase |

**After a transfer.** The pass keeps its expiry date, its visits remaining and the discount it was bought with; any open booking made for the old pet is cancelled without a fee.
